kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننقبض (form VII)
# نَنْقَبِضُ (nanqabiḍu) /nan.qa.bi.dˤu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
# نَنْقَبِضَ (nanqabiḍa) /nan.qa.bi.dˤa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
# نَنْقَبِضْ (nanqabiḍ) /nan.qa.bidˤ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْقَبَضَ (inqabaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
